indicators.name: Distribution Day Count
indicators.summary: Counts distribution days (down 0.2% or more on higher volume) over the last 25 sessions, and marks each one.

meta.name: Distribution Day Count
meta.description: the sum of (1 when ((1 when close is less than or equal to ((close 1 bar ago) times 0.998) and 0 otherwise) and (1 when volume is greater than (volume 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise)) is not zero, 0 when it is zero, and nothing while it is unknown) over the last 25 bars

inputs.label: Close at or below 0.998 times previous Close and Volume abo… colour
Close at or below 0.998 times previous Close and Volume abo… width

plots.label: Close at or below 0.998 times previous Close and Volume abo…

indicators.name: Relative Strength vs SPY
indicators.summary: The relative strength line against SPY (close divided by the close of SPY) with its 21-bar average.

inputs.label: EMA 21 (Close divided by SPY Close) colour
EMA 21 (Close divided by SPY Close) width

indicators.name: RS New High vs SPY
indicators.summary: Marks a new 52-week high in relative strength against SPY while price is still below its own 52-week high.

sources.sig: close / sym('SPY', close) >= highest(close / sym('SPY', close), 252) && high < highest(high, 252)

inputs.label: Close divided by SPY Close at or above HIGHEST 252 (Close d… colour
Close divided by SPY Close at or above HIGHEST 252 (Close d… width

plots.label: Close divided by SPY Close at or above HIGHEST 252 (Close d…

indicators.name: ATR Extension
indicators.summary: How far price is above its 50-day average, in multiples of the 14-day ATR. Red above 7, orange above 4.

sources.ext_cs: (close - sma(close, 50)) / atr(high, low, close, 14) > 7 ? 0 : (close - sma(close, 50)) / atr(high, low, close, 14) > 4 ? 1 : 2

meta.name: ATR Extension
meta.description: (close minus (the 50-bar average of close)) divided by (the 14-bar average true range of high, low and close)

indicators.name: Percent Distance from 10 Week MA
indicators.summary: The percent distance of the close from the 10-week average, with lines at +20% and -8%.

meta.name: Percent Distance from 10 Week MA
meta.description: ((close minus ((the 10-bar average of close) on the weekly timeframe)) divided by ((the 10-bar average of close) on the weekly timeframe)) times 100

indicators.name: Volume with 50 Average
indicators.summary: Volume with its 50-day average. Blue on an up day 40% above average, pink on a down day 40% above average.

sources.vol_cs: close > close[1] && volume > sma(volume, 50) * 1.4 ? 0 : close < close[1] && volume > sma(volume, 50) * 1.4 ? 1 : 2

inputs.label: Close above previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5… colour
Close above previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5… width
Close below previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5… colour
Close below previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5… width

plots.label: Close above previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5…
Close below previous Close and Volume above 1.4 times SMA 5…

indicators.name: Tight Weekly Closes
indicators.summary: Shades the background when the last three weekly closes are within 1.5% of each other.

compute.source: (max(tf(close, 'W'), max(tf(close[1], 'W'), tf(close[2], 'W'))) - min(tf(close, 'W'), min(tf(close[1], 'W'), tf(close[2], 'W')))) / min(tf(close, 'W'), min(tf(close[1], 'W'), tf(close[2], 'W'))) <= 0.015

meta.name: Tight Weekly Closes
meta.description: 1 when (((the larger of (close on the weekly timeframe) and (the larger of ((close 1 bar ago) on the weekly timeframe) and ((close 2 bars ago) on the weekly timeframe))) minus (the smaller of (close on the weekly timeframe) and (the smaller of ((close 1 bar ago) on the weekly timeframe) and ((close 2 bars ago) on the weekly timeframe)))) divided by (the smaller of (close on the weekly timeframe) and (the smaller of ((close 1 bar ago) on the weekly timeframe) and ((close 2 bars ago) on the weekly timeframe)))) is less than or equal to 0.015 and 0 otherwise

indicators.name: Gap Up on Volume
indicators.summary: Marks a gap up of 4% or more on above-average volume with an arrow under the bar.

meta.name: Gap Up on Volume
meta.description: (1 when (((open minus (close 1 bar ago)) divided by (close 1 bar ago)) times 100) is greater than or equal to 4 and 0 otherwise) and (1 when volume is greater than (the 50-bar average of volume) and 0 otherwise)

indicators.name: Inside / Outside Bars
indicators.summary: Paints inside bars grey and outside bars purple.

sources.candles_cs: high <= high[1] && low >= low[1] ? 0 : high > high[1] && low < low[1] ? 1 : 2

meta.name: Inside / Outside Bars
meta.description: (1 when high is less than or equal to (high 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise) and (1 when low is greater than or equal to (low 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise)

inputs.label: High above previous High and Low below previous Low colour
High above previous High and Low below previous Low width

plots.label: High above previous High and Low below previous Low

indicators.name: Average Daily Range %
indicators.summary: The 20-day average daily range in percent, and today's range as a share of it, in a small table.

meta.name: Average Daily Range %
meta.description: (the 20-bar average of ((high divided by low) minus 1)) times 100

indicators.name: Previous Week High/Low
indicators.summary: The previous week's high and low, drawn across this week's bars.

indicators.name: Flat Base
indicators.summary: Shades a flat base: a 25-session range under 15%, within 15% of the 52-week high, after an advance of 20% or more.

compute.source: highest(high, 25) <= lowest(low, 25) * 1.15 && close >= highest(high, 252) * 0.85 && close[25] >= close[125] * 1.2

meta.name: Flat Base
meta.description: ((1 when (the highest high of the last 25 bars) is less than or equal to ((the lowest low of the last 25 bars) times 1.15) and 0 otherwise) and (1 when close is greater than or equal to ((the highest high of the last 252 bars) times 0.85) and 0 otherwise)) and (1 when (close 25 bars ago) is greater than or equal to ((close 125 bars ago) times 1.2) and 0 otherwise)

indicators.name: Up/Down Volume Ratio (50)
indicators.summary: Volume on up days divided by volume on down days over 50 sessions, with a line at 1.0 and shading above 1.2.

compute.source: sum(close > close[1] ? volume : 0, 50) / sum(close < close[1] ? volume : 0, 50)

sources.udr: sum(close > close[1] ? volume : 0, 50) / sum(close < close[1] ? volume : 0, 50)
sources.strong: sum(close > close[1] ? volume : 0, 50) / sum(close < close[1] ? volume : 0, 50) > 1.2

meta.name: Up/Down Volume Ratio (50)
meta.description: (the sum of (volume when (1 when close is greater than (close 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise) is not zero, 0 when it is zero, and nothing while it is unknown) over the last 50 bars) divided by (the sum of (volume when (1 when close is less than (close 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise) is not zero, 0 when it is zero, and nothing while it is unknown) over the last 50 bars)

inputs.label: SUM 50 (Volume when Close above previous Close, else 0) div… colour
SUM 50 (Volume when Close above previous Close, else 0) div… width

plots.label: SUM 50 (Volume when Close above previous Close, else 0) div…

indicators.name: Follow-Through Day
indicators.summary: Marks a follow-through day: up 1.7% or more on higher volume, 4 to 12 bars after the 50-session low.

meta.name: Follow-Through Day
meta.description: ((1 when ((close minus (close 1 bar ago)) divided by (close 1 bar ago)) is greater than or equal to 0.017 and 0 otherwise) and (1 when volume is greater than (volume 1 bar ago) and 0 otherwise)) and ((1 when (the number of bars back to the bar holding the lowest low of the last 50 bars, the newest of a tie over a bar price and withheld on a tie over anything else) is greater than or equal to 4 and 0 otherwise) and (1 when (the number of bars back to the bar holding the lowest low of the last 50 bars, the newest of a tie over a bar price and withheld on a tie over anything else) is less than or equal to 12 and 0 otherwise))
